story.label: Where the name comes from
story.headline: Three ingredients. One skewer.
story.body: The name comes from the gilda, a Spanish tapa we were served in Seville: a green olive, a salt-cured anchovy and a pickled pepper on one skewer. Each ingredient is one branch of the studio. The skewer is the team that holds them together.
